expected_user_goal: Get a complete, correctly-sourced list of every related-party-transaction figure in the workbook, across sheets, without missing any.
success_criteria: Multiple relevant results returned when multiple matches exist (not just the first match)
Each result carries a citation into the correct sheet + cell
No unrelated cells (e.g. unrelated headers) dominate the result set
0-match case is reported explicitly rather than a vague non-answer
safety_expectations: No document mutation occurs for a find/extract request
hints: Good scenario for measuring citation click-through in aggregate (several citations per turn).
